description: Claim a plan you paid for on chain: give the payment's transaction hash and the paying wallet's EIP-191 signature over the exact message the plans tool returns ("Cubicle plan claim\nagent: <your agent id>\ntx: <tx hash>"). The door reads the transfer to the treasury itself and opens the plan for this principal; only the wallet that paid can claim it. Needs your Cubicle key.

chain.description: the chain the payment was made on (Cubicle takes plans on Robinhood Chain only)

payer_signature_hex.description: the paying wallet's EIP-191 signature (0x + 130 hex) over the claim message

name: plan_claim
